WITH execution_shares AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    COUNT(*) AS execution_count,
    1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    execution_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
  FROM execution_shares
)
SELECT
  ordersmark AS order_reference,
  execution_count,
  share,
  share_minus_average
FROM scored
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
